transcript.en: Hello English learners, welcome to another great lesson with EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod 的另一节精彩课程。

transcript.en: So, Erika, how are you today?
And I think we've got a good lesson today, a really helpful lesson.
transcript.zh: 我觉得今天的课程很不错，是一节非常有用的课。

transcript.en: What are we talking about today?
We have an elementary lesson about making an appointment.
transcript.zh: 我们有一节关于预约的初级课程。

transcript.en: I guess you have to make appointments for the doctor or...
transcript.zh: 我想你肯定需要预约看医生或者……
或者跟朋友约见面，没错。

transcript.en: So, this is language that you can use every day to make appointments.
transcript.zh: 所以，这是你每天都能用到的预约用语。

transcript.en: Well, so, why don't we take a look at our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 那么，我们先来看一下词汇预览吧。

transcript.en: We only have one word today which you need to know to understand this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 今天只有一个词需要你了解，才能理解这段对话。
那就是 financial advisor（理财顾问）。

transcript.en: So, what is a financial advisor?
transcript.zh: 那么，什么是理财顾问呢？

transcript.en: A financial advisor is a person who gives suggestions or recommendations about investing money.
transcript.zh: 理财顾问就是给你提供投资建议或推荐的人。

transcript.en: Someone who wants you to put money in the stock market.
transcript.zh: 就是想让你把钱投进股市的人。

transcript.en: I guess we're ready now to listen to our dialogue for the first time.
transcript.zh: 我想现在我们准备好第一次听对话了。

transcript.en: And as always, it's going to be at a normal speed, but you don't have to worry about it because...
transcript.zh: 和往常一样，会是正常语速，不过你不用担心，因为……

transcript.en: We'll come back and teach you all the important words.
transcript.zh: 我们会回来教你所有重要的单词。

transcript.en: And I'm calling to arrange an appointment with Ms. McNeely.
transcript.zh: 我打电话来是想预约麦克尼利女士。

transcript.en: What day were you thinking of?
Does she have any time available then?
Unfortunately, she's booked solid on Thursday.
transcript.zh: 不巧，她周四已经排满了。

transcript.en: How does next Monday work for you?
Actually, I've got something scheduled on Monday.
transcript.zh: 其实，我周一已经有安排了。

transcript.en: May I ask where you're calling from?
transcript.zh: 请问您是从哪里打来的？

transcript.en: Well, I guess Ms. McNeely does not want to speak to any financial advisors.
transcript.zh: 嗯，看来麦克尼利女士不想跟任何理财顾问说话。

transcript.en: Yeah, I guess she doesn't really want to invest in the stock market.
transcript.zh: 是啊，看来她并不太想投资股市。

transcript.en: Or maybe she just gets too many phone calls from them.
transcript.zh: 或者也许她只是接到太多这类电话了。

transcript.en: If you have money, I guess you'll get phone calls from people like that.
transcript.zh: 如果你有钱的话，我想你也会接到那种人的电话。

transcript.en: I guess we don't have that problem, hey?
transcript.zh: 我想我们应该没有这个问题吧？

transcript.en: Okay, let's start with our language takeaway for today.
transcript.zh: 好了，开始今天的关键用语吧。

transcript.en: Available, meaning that you are not busy.
Let's move to our next word.
I think we've got some examples of this phrase.
transcript.zh: 我想我们有几个关于这个短语的例子。

transcript.en: I think so, but let me just double check.
transcript.zh: 我想有的，不过让我再确认一下。

transcript.en: I thought I sent that email already, but let me double check.
transcript.zh: 我以为我已经发了那封邮件，不过让我再确认一下。

transcript.en: Okay, so double check basically means to check something twice.
transcript.zh: 好的，所以 double check 基本上就是检查两遍的意思。

transcript.en: Our third word for language takeaway today is scheduled.
transcript.zh: 今天关键用语的第三个词是 scheduled（已安排的）。

transcript.en: So, when you have something scheduled, it means that you have something planned, right?
transcript.zh: 那么，当你有 something scheduled，意思就是你有计划好的事情，对吧？

transcript.en: Yeah, or booked at that time.
transcript.zh: 对，或者说那个时间已经被预约了。
那个时间已经被预约了。

transcript.en: We've got a lunch scheduled this afternoon, don't we?
transcript.zh: 我们今天下午安排了午餐，对吧？

transcript.en: And our last word for today is booked solid.
transcript.zh: 今天我们最后一个词是 booked solid（排满了）。

transcript.en: So, we have some great words for today.
transcript.zh: 那么，今天我们有一些很棒的词。

transcript.en: We have a great word for today.
transcript.zh: 今天我们有一个很棒的词。

transcript.en: We have a great word for today.
transcript.zh: 今天我们有一个很棒的词。

transcript.en: We have a great word for today.
transcript.zh: 今天我们有一个很棒的词。

transcript.en: We have a great phrase for today, which is booked solid.
transcript.zh: 今天我们有一个很棒的短语，就是 booked solid。

transcript.en: So, we have some great examples on how you can use this great phrase, booked solid, and you can understand what it means.
transcript.zh: 我们有一些很好的例子，让你了解如何使用这个很棒的短语 booked solid，并理解它的意思。

transcript.en: I can't get a hotel room.
They're booked solid until after the New Year.
transcript.zh: 他们一直到新年过后都排满了。

transcript.en: I'm sorry, there are no seats available on this flight.
transcript.zh: 抱歉，这趟航班上没有空座了。

transcript.en: I'm booked solid over the Christmas holidays.
transcript.zh: 我圣诞节假期期间排满了。

transcript.en: Sorry, I can't meet with you today.
transcript.zh: 抱歉，我今天没法跟你见面。
那么，booked solid 基本上是？

transcript.en: You have no free time, no available time.
transcript.zh: 你没有空闲时间，没有任何可用的时间。

transcript.en: So, you've got appointments scheduled all day.
transcript.zh: 所以，你一整天的预约都排满了。

transcript.en: So, with this in mind, now we can listen to our dialogue a second time.
transcript.zh: 那么，带着这些理解，现在我们可以第二次听对话了。

transcript.en: This time, it's going to be slow, so we can understand a little bit better.
transcript.zh: 这一次会是慢速的，这样我们能理解得更好一些。
你好，费尔布鲁克咨询公司。

transcript.en: Yes, this is Julianne Horton, and I'm calling to arrange an appointment with Ms. McNeely.
transcript.zh: 是的，我是朱莉安·霍顿，我打电话来是想预约麦克尼利女士。

transcript.en: What date were you thinking of?
Does she have any time available then?
No, unfortunately, she's booked solid on Thursday.
transcript.zh: 不，不巧，她周四已经排满了。

transcript.en: How does next Monday work for you?
Actually, I've got something scheduled on Monday.
transcript.zh: 其实，我周一已经有安排了。

transcript.en: May I ask where you're calling from?
transcript.zh: 请问您是从哪里打来的？
当然，默顿财务顾问公司。

transcript.en: Okay, so now it's a little bit more clear, and with this, we can start with putting it together.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在清楚多了，接下来我们可以开始学习「组合运用」了。

transcript.en: There's some great examples in this dialogue of phrases you can use when you need to schedule an appointment, and we're going to look at those today.
transcript.zh: 这段对话中有一些很棒的例子，是你在需要预约时可以用到的短语，我们今天就来学习这些。

transcript.en: In the dialogue, we heard Julianne ask about making an appointment, and she said this.
transcript.zh: 在对话中，我们听到朱莉安询问预约的事，她是这样说的。

transcript.en: I'm calling to arrange an appointment with Ms. McNeely.
transcript.zh: 我打电话来是想预约麦克尼利女士。

transcript.en: I'm calling to arrange an appointment with Ms. McNeely.
transcript.zh: 我打电话来是想预约麦克尼利女士。

transcript.en: So this is a great way to schedule an appointment, to ask for some time from somebody else.
transcript.zh: 所以，这是一个很棒的预约方式，可以向别人请求安排时间。

transcript.en: Yeah, and we have some more examples of this phrase.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们还有更多关于这个短语的例子。

transcript.en: Please book an appointment for next week.
Please schedule an appointment for next week.
Great, so after that, when you're scheduling an appointment, you need to suggest a day when maybe that person has time.
transcript.zh: 很好，在那之后，当你预约时，你需要建议一个那个人可能有空的日子。

transcript.en: Yes, let's listen to what they said in the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们来听听他们在对话中是怎么说的。

transcript.en: How's Thursday? Does she have any time available then?
transcript.zh: 周四怎么样？她那天有空吗？

transcript.en: You say, well, how's Thursday or how's Tuesday?
transcript.zh: 你可以说，嗯，周四怎么样，或者周二怎么样？

transcript.en: And maybe that person doesn't have time that day, so they'll say something like this.
transcript.zh: 也许那个人那天没有时间，所以他们会这样说。

transcript.en: Okay, Erica, so if I want to have a meeting with you, I would say, how's Monday sound or how's Monday?
transcript.zh: 好的，Erika，如果我想跟你开会，我会说，周一听起来怎么样，或者说周一怎么样？

transcript.en: Monday's no good. I'm busy all day.
transcript.zh: 周一不行，我整天都很忙。

transcript.en: Okay, great, so we have a meeting on Wednesday.
transcript.zh: 好的，太好了，那我们周三开会。

transcript.en: Okay, yeah, those are some great phrases, hey, for scheduling an appointment.
transcript.zh: 好的，是啊，这些都是很棒的表达，对吧，用来预约的。

transcript.en: Okay, so now we can listen to our dialogue a third time and we're ready to understand everything that we've just talked about.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在我们可以第三次听对话了，我们已经准备好理解刚才讨论过的所有内容。

transcript.en: Hello, Fairbrook Consulting. How may I help you?
transcript.zh: 你好，费尔布鲁克咨询公司。有什么可以帮您？

transcript.en: Yes, this is Julianne Horton, and I'm calling to arrange an appointment with Ms. McNeely.
transcript.zh: 是的，我是朱莉安·霍顿，我打电话来是想预约麦克尼利女士。

transcript.en: Certainly. What day were you thinking of?
How's Thursday? Does she have any time available then?
transcript.zh: 周四怎么样？她那天有空吗？

transcript.en: Unfortunately, she's booked solid on Thursday. How does next Monday work for you?
transcript.zh: 不巧，她周四已经排满了。下周一您方便吗？

transcript.en: Actually, I've got something scheduled on Monday. Can't you do Tuesday?
transcript.zh: 其实，我周一已经有安排了。不能约周二吗？

transcript.en: Sure, Tuesday's perfect. May I ask where you're calling from?
transcript.zh: 当然，周二没问题。请问您是从哪里打来的？
当然，默顿财务顾问公司。

transcript.en: Oh, actually, Tuesday's no good. Sorry about that.
transcript.zh: 哦，其实，周二不行了。抱歉。

transcript.en: The language in this dialogue is really useful, isn't it, Marco?
transcript.zh: 这段对话中的语言真的很有用，对吧，Marco？

transcript.en: Yeah, it's from an everyday situation. You always have to make appointments at some point.
transcript.zh: 是的，这来自日常场景。你总会在某个时候需要预约的。

transcript.en: Yes, and like we said earlier, it's language you can use when you need to talk about work with your boss, maybe.
transcript.zh: 是的，就像我们之前说的，这是你在需要跟老板谈工作时可以用的语言。

transcript.en: Or when you need to do daily things, like go to the doctor.
transcript.zh: 或者当你需要做日常的事情时，比如去看医生。

transcript.en: Or even when you're planning something with your friends.
transcript.zh: 甚至当你跟朋友计划什么事的时候。

transcript.en: Yeah, you can use this in all those situations.
transcript.zh: 是的，你在所有这些场景中都可以用。

transcript.en: Great. Well, we're out of time now, but I hope you enjoyed our lesson and found it useful.
transcript.zh: 很好。时间到了，但我希望你们喜欢今天的课程，并觉得它有用。

transcript.en: And if you have any questions or comments, please go to our website at EnglishPod.com, where we'll be there to answer everything.
transcript.zh: 如果你们有任何问题或评论，请访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com，我们会在那里回答一切。

transcript.en: Yes, we will. So, thanks for listening, guys. And until next time, goodbye.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们会的。那么，感谢大家的收听，下次再见，拜拜。
